learned_patterns.role: SEEK search results and right-detail pane learning pattern.
SEEK full JD reading and latest detail snapshot pattern.
Full job detail text must be reviewed by Agent before Apply Entry.
Apply and Quick Apply open an application flow; they are not final submit.
Station-internal SEEK application form up to Review and submit.
Submit application and similar destructive/final actions are blocked by default.

prompt_context.learning_rule: The model must generate the draft. Reference assets are format/evaluation context only.

agent_prompt_requirements: User goals are interpreted by the Agent from conversation, not by a prewritten task-spec layer.
Job suitability must be decided by the Agent from the latest full job detail text, not from local keyword filtering or card snippets.
Human review is an Agent decision output such as ask_user_required, not a separate runtime layer.
Agent may use SEEK learned PathGraph assets when the current page state matches; otherwise it must continue through the generic observe-decision-action loop.
External ATS, login, CAPTCHA, missing profile evidence, and ambiguous application steps must produce ask_user_required or stop decisions.

strict_output_rules: Do not return {} for learned_* objects.
Every learned_* object must include all required_fields listed in reference_output_shape.
Use source_observation_evidence ids and semantic_action values when constructing states, regions, visual assets, transitions, actions, and danger zones.
If a list has no visible evidence, return an empty list for that field, not a missing field.
Use stable ids based on the app_id and evidence ids; do not invent unrelated names.
safety_requirements: Apply and Quick Apply are open_apply_flow, not final_submit.
Submit, Send, Confirm, Complete, Payment, Delete are final_submit/danger boundaries and hard-blocked.
All generated artifacts are observation_only and promotion_allowed=false.
Do not mark final submit as fast_lane_allowed.

learned_patterns.role: SEEK search results and right-detail pane learning pattern.
SEEK full JD reading and latest detail snapshot pattern.
Full job detail text must be reviewed by Agent before Apply Entry.
Apply and Quick Apply open an application flow; they are not final submit.
Station-internal SEEK application form up to Review and submit.
Submit application and similar destructive/final actions are blocked by default.

prompt_context.learning_rule: The model must generate the draft. Reference assets are format/evaluation context only.

agent_prompt_requirements: User goals are interpreted by the Agent from conversation, not by a prewritten task-spec layer.
Job suitability must be decided by the Agent from the latest full job detail text, not from local keyword filtering or card snippets.
Human review is an Agent decision output such as ask_user_required, not a separate runtime layer.
Agent may use SEEK learned PathGraph assets when the current page state matches; otherwise it must continue through the generic observe-decision-action loop.
External ATS, login, CAPTCHA, missing profile evidence, and ambiguous application steps must produce ask_user_required or stop decisions.

strict_output_rules: Do not return {} for learned_* objects.
Every learned_* object must include all required_fields listed in reference_output_shape.
Use source_observation_evidence ids and semantic_action values when constructing states, regions, visual assets, transitions, actions, and danger zones.
If a list has no visible evidence, return an empty list for that field, not a missing field.
Use stable ids based on the app_id and evidence ids; do not invent unrelated names.
safety_requirements: Apply and Quick Apply are open_apply_flow, not final_submit.
Submit, Send, Confirm, Complete, Payment, Delete are final_submit/danger boundaries and hard-blocked.
All generated artifacts are observation_only and promotion_allowed=false.
Do not mark final submit as fast_lane_allowed.
